description: Company monitoring for France: new official BODACC gazette announcements for a French company SINCE a given date (poll-mode watchlist surveillance for a portfolio), such as insolvency, deregistration, sales, filings and changes, in reverse-chronological order. Detects new BODACC publications, not field-level edits of the profile. A company with no new announcement returns an empty list. Judgments in closed fields (category, appointed officers by role and form, date of cessation of payments), never the judgment's text nor a natural person's name; withheld labels are counted in `omissions`. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

depuis.description: List announcements since this day. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD (a real date), or a full ISO 8601 timestamp (offset Z, ±HH:MM, ±HHMM or none, read as UTC): only its UTC day is kept.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_company_changes

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: French company changes (BODACC)
